title: Warlock perks: Throwables, Teleport Player, Sacrificial Lightning and Convert Mob
summary: The Warlock class gets its perks. Throwables makes snowballs, eggs and wind charges hurt, and lets you throw slimeballs and fire charges too. Teleport Player calls a friend to you, or a PlayerMob you met this life if it is willing to come. Sacrificial Lightning strikes a mob you look at for a price paid in your own hearts, and the bolt grows with every point. Convert Mob turns a hostile mob to your side for a while. None of them have a cap.
